result.reason: The redline adds the preferred categories of Licensor indemnity, but it does not reach either playbook position. Licensee’s indemnity remains broadly tied to all license use, business conduct, and any contractual breach rather than being limited to Licensee-provided content and breach of law. There are no standard notice, defense-control, or cooperation procedures. Further, Article XIII still expressly disclaims Licensor liability for infringement claims and caps all Licensor liability at one-half of fees, directly undermining the new IP indemnity and falling well below the fallback 3× annual-fees super-cap. The fallback IP exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies are also absent. The edits are targeted and preserve unrelated terms, but the operative provisions are internally inconsistent, and the margin comment inaccurately states that Licensee’s indemnity has been correspondingly limited.
